story: Trinidad Lake State Park is a state park located in Colorado, USA, protecting Trinidad Lake, a dammed reservoir. The park features hiking trails, camping and boating opportunities, and historical attractions such as coal mining ruins at Cokedale.
matters: A portion of the mountain route of the Santa Fe Trail runs through the park, and an exposure of the Cretaceous–Paleogene boundary is visible in the southern part.
name: Trinidad Lake State Park
